title: Submit the contact form successfully
description: A visitor can fill out the contact form on the landing page and see a success confirmation after submitting it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the name input field with a valid name
Fill in the email input field with a valid email address
Fill in the message input field with a valid message
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Switch the site language to Arabic
description: A visitor can change the landing page language and see the content update to Arabic.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the language toggle button
Verify the page content is displayed in Arabic
Verify the page layout updates for right-to-left text direction

title: Switch the site theme to dark mode
description: A visitor can change the landing page appearance to dark mode and see the visual theme update across the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the theme toggle button
Verify the dark theme is applied across the page

title: Keep the landing page usable after changing language and theme
description: A visitor can switch language and theme on the landing page and still use the contact form afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the language toggle button
Click the theme toggle button
Fill in the name input field with a valid name
Fill in the email input field with a valid email address
Fill in the message input field with a valid message
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Switch the site language back to English
description: A visitor can toggle from Arabic back to English and see the original landing page language restored.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the language toggle button
Click the language toggle button
Verify the page content is displayed in English
Verify the page layout updates for left-to-right text direction

title: Switch the site theme back to light mode
description: A visitor can toggle from dark mode back to light mode and see the visual theme return to the default appearance.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the theme toggle button
Click the theme toggle button
Verify the light theme is applied across the page

title: Keep the landing page language switchable after submitting the form
description: A visitor can submit the contact form and then switch the landing page language without breaking the page controls.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the name input field with a valid name
Fill in the email input field with a valid email address
Fill in the message input field with a valid message
Submit the contact form
Click the language toggle button
Verify the page content is displayed in the alternate language
Verify the page remains usable after submission
